description:
aweb.secrets.change/1 (docs/design/secrets.md §6.3): a frozen set of widening changes an owner confirms with a passkey through B2. The approval covers "aweb.approval-request/1
" || canonical_json({policy, request}), with the change set as the request. Positive cases carry those exact bytes and their SHA-256. Negative cases never reach them: refused encodings and shapes, or other bytes. Confirmation cases fix when a change set can be confirmed: for the current installation, generation and team, at the revision it was drafted on, before it expires; confirmer cases fix who may confirm under the installation's four-eyes setting in force at confirmation (decision 61). A change set relaxes four eyes but never requires it, which is applied directly. A change set lives at most seven days. Principals are exact did:aw or Ed25519 did:key strings. A secret, destination, operation, grant, grant template or policy after is that record v1, checked whole; a policy is referenced by the SHA-256 of "aweb.secrets.policy/1
" || canonical_json(after without v), and an operation by operation_id and the SHA-256 of "aweb.secrets.operation/1
" || canonical_json(after without v). The after shapes of job and runner are added by S15; until then those kinds are refused. Identifiers are fixtures; DIDs are derived from fixed seeds.
